questions.question: An exam case presents two observations: (I) a TCP segment acknowledges previously received sequence data; (II) a client receives fraudulent domain-resolution information. Which pairing MOST accurately identifies I and II, in that order?

options.D: TCP ACK flag ; DNS cache poisoning

questions.explanation: I describes tcp ack flag; II describes dns spoofing. The pair must be correct in both positions.

questions.question: An exam case presents two observations: (I) malicious code resides in areas involved in a machine's startup sequence; (II) a host responds but no application is listening on the tested port. Which pairing MOST accurately identifies I and II, in that order?
questions.explanation: I describes boot-sector malware; II describes closed port. The pair must be correct in both positions.
